newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Circus Circus cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Circus Circus cut.

text.p: -- BT Securities Corp said it downgraded Circus Circus Enterprises Inc to market perform from buy.
-- cited Circus Circus' fourth quarter performance and market conditions in Nevada and the emerging markets.
-- cut fiscal 1998 earnings estimates to $1.60 a share from $1.90 a share and trimmed the 1999 estimate to $1.76 a share from $2.40 a share.
-- said weak performance at the Luxor and Circus Circus Las Vegas properties are likley to continue in the next few months as some construction disruption remains.
